quote: Carefully read the submission guidelines? If rigid pass/fail criteria, is what you're proposing exactly what they suggested?
implication: Re-read the brief's literal packaging rules before proposing structure; quote the rule and map each deliverable to it.

quote: Remember they shared these resources; maybe a clue how they bundle and use README design pattern
implication: Mine the employer's own sample artifacts for house style (README layout, bundling) and mirror it.

quote: Remember hiring manager's profile; conduct a persona-led gauntlet once dress rehearsal is confident
implication: Run grading panel/persona gauntlet against brief, video and site steps before declaring done; keep persona in memory.

quote: yes, go ahead / do all of A through D, then rehearse / yes, make the batch
implication: Present a lettered option list with a recommendation; user approves in bulk, then execute fully and rehearse.

quote: add the currency conversion test case beside T2 / add four document faults before rc36
implication: Expect late test-case additions; keep test set extensible and re-run rehearsal after each.

quote: Bench is missing a quick-start CLI copy-paste snippet with parameterized args
implication: Ship a copy-paste quick start with arguments on first build; non-technical reviewers need it.

quote: I want that board pre-populated with each of the cold runs as proof
implication: Pre-populate demo surfaces with proof artifacts; do not leave boards empty for reviewers.

quote: Light mode for all including the bench; dark toggle only for the deck
implication: Default to light mode; dark only where user names it.

quote: check out the open browser tab in comet
implication: Look at the live UI in the browser instead of reasoning from code; user keeps tabs open as ground truth.

quote: These pages should conform to global nav and styling rules and all be up to date; build log is static, bad UX
implication: Apply one shared nav/style pattern to every page; auto-refresh logs; audit all pages, not the one touched.

quote: Where's the final zip for submission and is the readme welcome page on monday updated too?
implication: After any change, state where the final bundle is and sync every mirror (zip, README, monday doc, GitHub, PDF).

quote: sorry did it make its way to github?
implication: Report push/merge status unprompted at the end of each change.

quote: is this still running? / any update? / make sure we're not idling out or erroring out
implication: Surface progress and liveness on long jobs without being asked; show logs in terminal.

quote: Yeah, lets land the plane / land the plane on the need-to-haves and table it for now
implication: Bias to closing: put nice-to-haves in todo.md, finish the release candidate first.

quote: lets not do that now
implication: Do not expand; park proposed extras unless asked.

quote: Ran a review in perplexity and crawled the github; go through a thorough reconciliation of what it flagged
implication: Treat external review as input: reconcile every flag item by item, with disposition (fixed, deferred, rejected).

quote: Add a todo.md to show future JTBD and observations needing external peer safeguards and agentic pipeline reviews
implication: Keep a visible backlog with unblock criteria so scope cuts read as judgment, not gaps.

quote: should we flag limiting API calls on free tier and monday model vs external as security nice-to-haves
implication: Flag security and tier limits as documented caveats rather than building them.

quote: 6th card on start page with embedded YouTube video before the deck, in case somebody skips the readme
implication: Assume reviewers skip documents; make the first screen self-explaining. Ask user's view, then add.

quote: Sam says I have enterprise access now; check that in the background
implication: Verify access/credential changes when told and re-plan blocked items.

quote: need a proper title card for the YouTube thumbnail, 720p; maybe an end card too
implication: Anticipate packaging assets (thumbnail, end card) for submission.

quote: get rid of the stylesheet FOUT on Try it live page, about 1/3 second lag
implication: Check load behavior (FOUT, font fallbacks) and offline/local-first rendering.

quote: fixed three-column grid for each fold-out row so titles start and wrap at same place
implication: Align rows to a shared grid; check wrapping across all pages.

quote: Did you use comet on the monday boards to enter questions on front end vs backend, as proof of non-technical UX?
implication: Prove claims through the reviewer's actual path (the monday UI), with screenshots, not only the backend.

quote: Ensure the one-shot CLI command doesn't require multiple steps for user error; single one-shot shell script
implication: Collapse setup to one command; minimize reviewer error surface.

quote: I don't understand how it works on the board / can you specify the difference
implication: Explain mechanisms plainly, with a table in the docs; user is not following the technical path.

quote: can you just populate the question into that column? with a [live] item tag?
implication: Make UI behavior uniform for staff; accept the simpler visible convention.

quote: Where to turn off the public link on the boards? Is the boards page synced with the real board?
implication: Surface exposure and sync risks yourself; guide the user step by step through UI-only settings.

quote: Can anybody on the reviewer end submit to public boards? Where are links included, hyperlinks in the pdf?
implication: Walk the reviewer journey end to end: access, links, permissions.

quote: look at the most recently generated pdf and check freshness and accuracy; so good to submit rc44?
implication: Run a freshness and claim audit on the final artifact and give an explicit go/no-go.

quote: add my name, email and number on page 1 so it's identifiable if shared outside the zip
implication: Put authorship and contact on page 1 and footers; ask before the final cut.

quote: natural-language terminal chat instead of CLI commands: add Level 1 to todo.md as nice-to-have
implication: Estimate effort, then park in the backlog; keep the RC frozen.

quote: ping the take-home session to apply the patch / check if it applied / check origin/main again
implication: User acts as router between sessions; confirm delivery and landing with commit sha, never claim delivered unverified.

quote: check the other session to ensure we're in sync and not clobbering one vs the other
implication: Declare file ownership and check sibling sessions before editing shared assets.

quote: fully rethink the video and audit every claim in the deck (relayed)
implication: Audit claims against evidence before polishing production values; expect restarts on narrative.

quote: Where does the video live? Shouldn't be in the latest build zip folder
implication: Keep large media out of the submission zip; state location of every asset.

quote: Get rid of that per-slide timer; lock the grid, slower sweep, cleaner motion
implication: Prefer calm, crisp motion; remove decorative progress indicators.

quote: I'm submitting / great just shipped
implication: User ships on own signal; keep final state clean and answer last-minute questions briefly.
